verdict.rationale: Synthesia offers automation surfaces (Video API, webhooks, MCP), so versioning and rolling back automations is a fair question for this product. The evidence never documents versioning, review, or rollback of automations. The collaboration review workflow in docs-12 covers video projects, not automations, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
